name: openbb_unemployment
description:
Unemployment rate (percent) for a country from the OECD through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.unemployment).
Returns: {country, provider, data_points, truncated, data: [records with date, country, value]} or {country, error}.
Inputs (* required): country (e.g. united_states, france; default united_states); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (oecd; default oecd).
US-only: av_unemployment, fred_unemployment. Keys: oecd needs none.
Example: {"country": "france"}

country.description: Country, lower case with underscores, e.g. united_states, japan

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
